name: Dropbox MCP
description: Lets agents search, read, create, move, and share Dropbox files and Paper docs over a hosted OAuth MCP server in beta.

skills.name: File Search
skills.description: Searches Dropbox files and folders by name or content, filtered by folder, file type, or last updated date.

skills.name: File Content Extraction
skills.description: Extracts text from PDFs, Word documents, and other text-representable files up to 5 MB, with a Dropbox link for each.

skills.name: Shared Links And Requests
skills.description: Creates shared links with up to 25 invited viewers, and creates file requests so others can upload to a chosen folder.

skills.name: File Operations
skills.description: Copies, moves, renames, and deletes files or folders, and lists or restores a file's revision history.

skills.name: Paper Docs
skills.description: Reads, summarizes, creates, and edits Dropbox Paper docs the user can already access, and reviews changes to a doc.
